deprecation_criterion: Superseded by the next packaging-config housekeep wave's baseline; single-use measured-reduction reference for this doc-slim wave.
description: Line counts of packaging-config doc surfaces. spec.md peaked at 588 lines when it carried 17 historical `## Plugin patch/minor vX.Y.Z` release-note sections (v0.5.0 -> v0.8.0). Per coding-rules and the principle that history belongs in docs/CHANGELOG.md never in the doc surface, those 17 release-note sections were removed from spec.md and folded into docs/CHANGELOG.md, re-anchoring spec.md to 305 lines (living spec only: Purpose, paths, public surface, current behavior, invariants; every load-bearing token preserved verbatim). The #355 version-monotonicity-on-content-change invariant then added a 9-line bullet to the invariants list, re-anchoring spec.md to 314 lines. The RABBIT_GATE release-hygiene-skip invariant then added a 13-line bullet to the invariants list, re-anchoring spec.md to 327 lines. Registering the /auto-maintainer:clobber control skill + clobber.py lib in build_plugin then expanded the Shipped-control-skills bullet with the new-control-skill registration rule (lib map + curated _COMMAND_DESCRIPTIONS entry, count/enumeration tests advanced in lockstep), adding 7 lines and re-anchoring spec.md to 334 lines. Shipping RECONCILE + reject-label exclusion in the default-config (Wave-2) then added the Shipped-default-config-wiring section, re-anchoring spec.md to 350 lines. Re-authoring that section for the neutral pull-all issue_filter default (schema 2.9.0, interval 10, release v0.26.0) then added 3 lines, re-anchoring spec.md to 353 lines. Adding the 'Plugin minor v0.27.0' release note (re-ship of safety-governance 0.17.0's configure.py: render_config default --show view + --json flag + exclude_labels catalog entry) then added 11 lines, re-anchoring spec.md to 364 lines. Adding the 'Plugin minor v0.28.0' release note (re-ship of the RECONCILE prior-verdict conflict race-breaker: verify-integrate 0.10.0's lib/verify_integrate.py + scheduling 0.42.0's lib/run_tick.py prior_verdicts seeding + lib/status.py DEFAULT_GOVERNANCE heartbeat default) then added 12 lines, re-anchoring spec.md to 376 lines. Adding the 'Plugin minor v0.29.0' release note (re-ship of the auto-merge-completion observability: verify-integrate 0.11.0's lib/verify_integrate.py reconcile_result.auto_merged + scheduling 0.43.0's lib/run_tick.py tick_end auto_merged surfacing + terminal ledger stamp) then added 11 lines, re-anchoring spec.md to 387 lines. Adding the 'Plugin minor v0.30.0' release note (re-ship of the loop-convergence fixes: verify-integrate 0.11.1 + scheduling 0.44.0 + implement 0.11.0, plus the build change registering open_pr.py in _LIBS so the shipped implementer agent v2.11.0 can invoke ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/lib/open_pr.py) then added 16 lines, re-anchoring spec.md to 403 lines. Adding the 'Plugin minor v0.31.0' release note (re-ship of the RECONCILE worktree-robustness + recovery observability: verify-integrate 0.11.2's lib/verify_integrate.py reconcile_rebase_worktree unique-mkdtemp+prune-before-add + scheduling 0.45.0's lib/run_tick.py tick_end rebased/relanded/reconcile_errors surfacing) then added 12 lines, re-anchoring spec.md to 415 lines. Adding the 'Plugin minor v0.32.0' release note (re-ship of the audit-wave RECONCILE fixes: verify-integrate 0.12.0's lib/verify_integrate.py hooks-free disposable-worktree/GATE git ops + gh_closing_issue_ref graphql/`Closes #N` fallback, scheduling 0.46.0's lib/run_tick.py -wo issue_ref canonicalization, and implement 0.11.1's lib/open_pr.py hooks-free worktree add) then added 12 lines, re-anchoring spec.md to 427 lines. Adding the 'Plugin minor v0.33.0' release note (re-ship of the loop-convergence wave: work-intake 0.12.0's lib/work_intake.py is_in_flight + Pull(in_flight_issue_refs) unconditional PULL exclusion, implement 0.12.0's lib/implement.py already_done terminal Handoff status schema 1.2.0 + agent v2.12.0, and scheduling 0.47.0's lib/run_tick.py in-flight issue-ref computation + already_done terminal-resolved triage_memory skip) then added 19 lines, re-anchoring spec.md to 446 lines. This baseline tracks that current spec.md line count so the no-growth gate stays consistent. The housekeep e2e test asserts the current docs are no LARGER than these baselines (a reduced|no-op verdict), spec.md is not larger, and the load-bearing tokens survived the slim.
